subject: Purchase mandate carveout request for pilot onboarding - FastFlow Labs
messages:
From: Dana Shobe <dana.shobe@fastflowlabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@fastflowlabs.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding + invoice-only carveout for pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo — FastFlow Labs is excited to trial Redwood's inference offering. We have a small engineering pilot (3 months) that will start next week. Our procurement process is still being set up (we're a Series A org) and we don't yet have a formal PO system.

Can Redwood make an exception so we can be onboarded on an invoice-only path for the pilot (Net30)? We'll sign whatever SOW/MSA is required, and I attached the SOW and a completed W-9. Our accounting email is accounts@fastflowlabs.com.

If a PO is strictly required, can you advise the minimal steps to expedite it?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we want to get usage started by Monday.

Best,
Dana Shobe
Head of Ops, FastFlow Labs
Dana.Shobe@fastflowlabs.com
attachments: FastFlow_SOW.pdf (application/pdf), W-9_FastFlow.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Shobe <dana.shobe@fastflowlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding + invoice-only carveout for pilot

Hi Dana — thanks for the SOW and context. Really glad to hear the pilot is starting so soon.

Quick answers up front: we can make a limited, timeboxed exception for pilot engagements but need to lock a few controls first. To move forward I need the following from you:
- a named billing contact (email + phone) 
- expected spend during the 90-day pilot (ballpark is fine)
- confirmation you'll accept Redwood's standard MSA (we can send a redline-lite for pilot scope)
- copy of your bank letter or vendor verification (helps with credit checks)

Karthik from our procurement team is looped for policy signoff. If you can send the items above by EOD Friday we should be able to provision access and put the pilot on an invoice-only path for up to 90 days with the following conditions:
- max cumulative invoiced amount capped (procurement sets exact threshold)
- preapproved billing contact for payment follow-ups
- evidence on vendor identity (W-9 + bank letter)

I will follow up with Karthik on the allowable threshold and any finance hold items.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 415-555-0172

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding + invoice-only carveout for pilot

Vanessa / Marissa — reviewed FastFlow's request. Procurement policy (summary):
- Default: PO required for all supplier relationships.
- Exception: temporary invoice-only allowed for early-stage pilots where vendor cannot produce a PO, subject to risk controls and a cap.

Proposal for this case (recommended):
1) Approve a 90-day invoice-only carveout limited to $15,000 total invoiced spend for the pilot.
2) Require: W-9, bank letter (or recent vendor remittance), named billing contact, and signed pilot SOW/MSA (redline-lite).
3) Finance to perform a soft credit verification prior to first invoice.
4) Add a clause: immediate suspension of services if invoice > 7 days past due after reminder.

Rationale: small pilot with clear scope; $15k cap limits finance exposure. If FastFlow needs >$15k we should require a PO and upfront payment terms. 

If you both approve, I'll stamp the exception and ask Finance to enable the vendor record as 'Invoice-only: Pilot (90d)'.

-Karthik
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

(Internal note: check for any prior bankruptcies; run vendor lookup in Coupa/ERP)

We can accept the $15k cap and the 90-day window. Attached is a bank letter and a short cover note from our CFO confirming the pilot intent. Billing contact for this engagement is: accounts@fastflowlabs.com (Mel Chen, Billing Lead, +1 650-555-0119).

We are fine with your redline-lite MSA for the pilot — please send the doc and we'll get it signed. We'll aim to keep monthly invoices under $5k.

Attachments: FastFlow_BankLetter.pdf

Dana
